create_scannetpp_dataset: create a ScannetppDataset instance with a custom folder path, patch size, and number of patches
iterate_scannetpp_samples: iterate over ScannetppDataset to yield batches of multi-view ray origins, directions, and images
get_multi_view_dataset_iter: get a MultiViewDatasetConfig iterator for a given ScanNetpp scene folder with patch pixel sampling
get_total_samples: get the total number of samples available in the ScannetppDataset
enable_ray_augmentation: enable ray augmentation on ScannetppDataset to randomly rotate and scale ray origins and directions
